Each insulator features embossed markings including 'HEMINGRAY-42' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. The insulators show signs of dirt and minor residue consistent with age. See photos for detailed condition.

Large Lot Vintage New Sealed 8mm Hi8 Digital8 Video Tapes Sony Maxell TDK
This large assorted lot includes vintage and new sealed 8mm, Hi8, and Digital8 video cassette tapes from brands such as Sony, Maxell, TDK, Fujifilm, and Panasonic. Formats included are 8mm GX-MP, Hi8 HMP, Digital8, and Video8. Tape lengths vary, mostly 120 minutes with some 60, 90, and 135 minutes. Types include MP, XR-Metal, EHG, HS, and head cleaners. Most tapes are in their original sealed packaging and appear unused, although some may show minor shelf wear.
